parsed.memo: When a project previously prioritized exploration over maintaining commitments (weights 8 and 1) and achieved its old objective, a compact rule for retaining useful prior commitments while accepting revisions is: preserve the prior commitment as a default only when it remains consistent with the current authenticated weights and no contradictory evidence has been presented; if later tasks change the authenticated weights or introduce contradictory evidence, revise the commitment accordingly, giving priority to the updated weights and evidence over the prior commitment.
